description: ECLIPS provides European climate indices derived from bias-corrected EURO-CORDEX simulations. Five regional-model combinations and RCP4.5 and RCP8.5 scenarios support multiyear climate summaries for historical and future periods. Version 1.1 supplies 0.11-degree ASCII maps; version 2.0 downscales a subset of the indices to 30 arcseconds, with GeoTIFF distribution described in the journal article. Both Zenodo deposits are free under CC-BY-4.0. The indices can inform water-demand, renewable-resource and heat-exposure scenarios in infrastructure simulations. They complement time-resolved climate projections with ready-made seasonal and annual indicators. Downscaling does not create independent local observations, and multiyear summaries cannot reproduce daily event sequences. The version 2.0 metadata describe 80 indices for the overall family while explicitly limiting that version to a subset. They also print one future interval as 2021–2140. That unresolved label should be checked against the product documentation before selecting a period; it has not been silently changed to 2040.
